{{Quote|Well, as you can tell by looking at me, I'm a journalist. I write for all of the major News HoloStations throughout the galaxy, and am well known for my surprise exposes.|The journalist, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Excited Journalist|Corellia}}</ref>}}
A '''journalist''' worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] wrote for various major news [[HoloStation]]s throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was well known for her surprise exposes.<ref name="SWG:EJ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the journalist asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on the streets of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] to visit the [[Imperial Stronghold (Corellia)|Imperial Stronghold]] on Corellia. They could not visit the base themself, as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was aware of their activities and did not allow them to get near the stronghold. The journalist uploaded the stronghold's coordinates to the spacer's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], hoping that they could use the adventurer's observations in future news stories.<ref name="SWG:EJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of the excited journalist]]
The "excited journalist" was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> 

The journalist was one of many herald NPCs that were added to the game shortly after its launch to point players to dungeons and other points of interest. When a player talked to them and agreed to help, a [[:w:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] to the Imperial Stronghold was added to the player's datapad. If the player talked to her again, the same dialogue started from the beginning.<ref name="SWG:EJ" />

Because the excited journalist spawned under the generic "commoner" template, their appearance was randomly generated among 120 possible appearances. This included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] of either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and male [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]].<ref name="SWG:EJ" />
